comparison.objective: After a printer cools, replace its used print plate with a clean plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Signal-conditioned bimanual level carrying and plate placement around locating pins.
comparison.success_condition: Wait for green, keep the loose print aboard, place the used plate flat on its rest, fit the clean plate flat on the bed, release, and stabilize for one second.
comparison.reason: Tests delayed plate exchange and level transport; it has no impact tool use, fracture, retained insert, or loose tang recovery.
